name: Enshrouding Darkness
text: Magical ability. Until the end of the battleround, fighters within (X/2)" of this fighter are not visible to fighters more than 1" away from them.

name: Gnawdoom
text: Magical ability. Select an enemy fighter within 6" and roll (X) d6. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Defense characteristic, allocate 2 damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Murder-Stab
text: Add (X/2) to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from the next melee attack action made by this fighter in this activation.

name: One With The Shadows
text: A fighter cannot use this ability when visible to enemy fighters or when carrying treasure tokens. Remove this fighter from the battlefield. This fighter is now hidden.

name: Pack Tactics
text: Select a visible friendly Henchman within 3" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free move action or a free attack action.

name: Skitterleap
text: Magical ability. A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter or when carrying a treasure token. Remove this fighter from the battlefield, then set it up on the battlefield floor or on a platform, more than 6" from all enemy warriors, objective markers and treasure tokens.
